values.en: For a regular smooth parametrized surface $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$, a base point $q\in\Omega$ and vectors $w,z\in T_{q}X$ in the tangent plane at $q$, the **first fundamental form** is the inner product induced on the tangent plane: $\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;w,z)=\langle w,z\rangle$ (also written $\mathrm{I}_{q}(w,z)$). In the basis $\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ its coefficients are $E=\langle\partial_{1}X,\partial_{1}X\rangle$, $F=\langle\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X\rangle$, $G=\langle\partial_{2}X,\partial_{2}X\rangle$, so that $\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;a\partial_{1}X(q)+b\partial_{2}X(q),c\partial_{1}X(q)+d\partial_{2}X(q))=Eac+F(ad+bc)+Gbd$. The symmetric matrix $\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$ is positive definite: $E>0$, $G>0$ and $EG-F^{2}>0$.
values.zh-CN: 对正则光滑参数曲面 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$、基点 $q\in\Omega$ 及切平面中的向量 $w,z\in T_{q}X$，**第一基本形式**是切平面上诱导的内积：$\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;w,z)=\langle w,z\rangle$（也写作 $\mathrm{I}_{q}(w,z)$）。在基 $\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ 下其系数为 $E=\langle\partial_{1}X,\partial_{1}X\rangle$、$F=\langle\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X\rangle$、$G=\langle\partial_{2}X,\partial_{2}X\rangle$，从而 $\mathrm{I}_{X}(q;a\partial_{1}X(q)+b\partial_{2}X(q),c\partial_{1}X(q)+d\partial_{2}X(q))=Eac+F(ad+bc)+Gbd$。对称矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$ 正定：$E>0$、$G>0$ 且 $EG-F^{2}>0$。
